Smoke: candidate public_val_bpb exceeds the same-host smoke control by more than 0.002 -> compiled Muon numerics diverge from eager; abort before full

Full: steps > +10% of same-host control -> EXCESS-GAIN-REVIEW; no quality claim without a matched-step numerics sanity check

expected_effect: Direction: lower public_val_bpb via more optimizer steps in the fixed 1800 s. Predeclared size: candidate steps +2% to +6% over the same-host control (>=2113 on trn21 or >=2118 on trn22 for +2%), and public_val_bpb lower than the same-host control by 0.001 to 0.004 (e.g. trn21 <= 1.0047, trn22 <= 1.0050). Smoke prediction: >= 335 steps in 300 s on either host and smoke BPB within +0.002 of the same-host smoke control (1.165855 trn21, 1.165604 trn22). If steps stay within +/-1% of control the mechanism is falsified as inert; if steps rise >= 1% but BPB does not fall, the compiled numerics or the step-to-quality translation is falsified.
hypothesis: At the 9a4caa7b default shape (592.9M params, seq 2048, ~1.15 steps/s, 2071-2076 steps in 1800 s) the Muon optimizer's per-step Newton-Schulz orthogonalization over the large 2-D weight matrices is dispatched as an eager graph and is a material fraction of the ~0.87 s step. Passing --compile-muon compiles that optimizer update into a single traced graph, shortening the optimizer phase without changing the update rule, so the fixed 1800 s budget yields more optimizer steps and a lower public_val_bpb. This is a throughput-first causal chain: the ledger row al-20260922-no-qk-shift-fixedbudget-r3 (2080 vs 2076 steps, 1.005766 vs 1.005967) shows small step gains translate to small BPB gains when the update rule is unchanged, whereas al-20260922-batch-ramp-only-default-shape (2397 steps, 1.01219) shows extra steps do not help when the update rule itself changes; --compile-muon is intended to be in the first class. Numerical equivalence of the compiled Muon step to the eager step is a hypothesis to be tested by the smoke BPB delta, not an established fact.
single_causal_change: Pass --compile-muon only. Every other option stays at the 9a4caa7b defaults used by the two pinned controls: identical launch shape (NEURON_LOGICAL_NC_CONFIG=2, torchrun --nproc_per_node=4, --num-steps 5000, --max-train-seconds 1800, --seed 42), identical environment (NEURON_CC_FLAGS exactly '--optlevel=1', NEURON_COMPETITION_R1_SEED=42, PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1), no other kernel or compile flag (no --nki-muon, --nki-attn, --nki-local-conv, --nki-relu2, --nki-rope-norm, --nki-softcap-ce, --compile-sdpa-direct), no precision flag (no --bf16-norm-output, --bf16-sdpa-input, --ngram-rms-fp32, --muon-lr-fp32), no optimizer-rule, schedule, batch, architecture, or evaluation change. The only behavioral delta is that the Muon optimizer step executes as a compiled graph instead of eager dispatch; the update rule, learning rates, momentum, and parameter groups are unchanged. Pre-full check: the candidate's resolved configuration dump/launch log must show compile_muon resolving to True while the pinned controls (which do not pass the flag) resolve to False; if the control already resolves True, classify FALSIFIED-INERT without spending the full run. Comparison: same-host pinned control on public_val_bpb (trn21 -> 2071 steps / 1.005734; trn22 -> 2076 steps / 1.005967). Outcome classes, mutually exclusive, evaluated in order: (1) CONFOUNDED-SHORT if candidate steps < 90% of same-host control steps (<1864 trn21, <1869 trn22; experiment-protocol.md section 5 rule; record as throughput regression only); (2) FALSIFIED-INERT if steps are within +/-1% of control (compiled path not faster or not reached); (3) EXCESS-GAIN-REVIEW if steps > +10% of control (>2278 trn21, >2283 trn22): record throughput and BPB but require a matched-step numerics sanity check before any quality claim (a separately declared conservative upper rule, not the protocol's short-step rule); (4) SUCCESS if steps >= +1.5% (>=2103 trn21, >=2108 trn22) and public_val_bpb < same-host control; (5) FALSIFIED-QUALITY if steps >= +1% and public_val_bpb >= same-host control (extra steps did not translate, or compiled numerics differ unfavorably); (6) INCONCLUSIVE if the step gain is between +1% and +1.5%.
